facts.fact: Rwanda was among the Uganda, Kenya, Rwanda and South Sudan officials at the Northern Corridor Integration Projects implementation clusters meeting in Kampala, a programme covering a single digital market, roaming costs and a joint satellite; the meeting is dated only by the report, 2026-08-24.

Uganda, Kenya, Rwanda and South Sudan opened a joint bank account at Standard Chartered Bank Uganda to fund a feasibility study of a jointly owned communications satellite, with a 30 September 2026 deposit deadline; the date of opening is not given, so the report date 2026-08-24 is used.
